description: GitHub Templates and Community Standards - Create PR template, issue templates (bug report, feature request), and verify CODEOWNERS file.
steps: Create .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md with sections for: Description, Type of Change, Testing, Checklist, Screenshots (if applicable)
Create .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md with sections for: Description, Steps to Reproduce, Expected Behavior, Actual Behavior, Environment, Screenshots
Create .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md with sections for: Problem Statement, Proposed Solution, Alternatives Considered, Additional Context
Verify .github/CODEOWNERS file exists and is properly configured (already exists, just verify)
Create .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report-tr.md and feature_request-tr.md Turkish translations (or include Turkish sections in templates)
acceptance_criteria: Turkish translations exist or templates include Turkish sections
